facts.fact: Sierra Leone's Right to Access Information Commission acted under the Right to Access Information Act 2013 on a request to the Corporate Affairs Commission.
The Commission cites the Right to Access Information Regulations 2022 as made under the Act, alongside the Act itself.
The Commission fined the Corporate Affairs Commission NLe80,000 for missing the 15-working-day deadline on a request of 18 June 2024 and ordered the information provided.
